spans.s:
√2dṛ (driyáte; ádṛta; dṛtá; -dṛ́tya).
used only w. ā, see 773. [cf. √δελ in δεν-
δίλλω, ‘glance at’; AS. tilian, 'be intent
upon, attend to, esp. the earth, i. e. till (the
soil),’ Eng. till; Ger. zielen, ‘aim at’; AS.
eorð-tilia, ‘earth-tiller.’]
+ ā, (look at, i. e.) regard; pass. be regarded,
 i. e. respected.
